# Maglin Site Furniture

> > Maglin Site Furniture designs and manufactures premium outdoor furniture including benches, bike racks, bollards, and shade structures like the ROMA Sun Shade for landscape architecture and urban design projects.

Maglin specializes in site furnishings for residential, commercial, and public spaces, featuring signature collections like the 400 Series, FLEXX panel system, and Maglin Minis for children. The company offers continuing education courses and showcases projects across North America with materials including Ipe wood, aluminum, and powder-coated finishes.

## Key Topics

- Outdoor furniture and site furnishings
- Landscape architecture solutions
- ROMA Sun Shade by GIBILLERO Design
- Benches (400 Series, 2400 Series)
- Bike racks and bollards
- Ipe wood and sustainable materials
- Powder coating and RAL finishes
- FLEXX panel system
- Maglin Minis children's furniture
- Urban design and public spaces
- Residential amenities
- LEED certification compatibility
- Continuing education (AIA, IDCEC)
- Custom site furniture projects

- [Benches](https://www.maglin.com/products/benches): Main benches product category page featuring outdoor seating solutions

- [ROMA Sun Shade](https://www.maglin.com/collections/roma-sun-shade): ROMA Sun Shade collection: perforated aluminum shade structures by GIBILLERO
- [SC Bollards](https://www.maglin.com/product/sc-bollards): SC Bollards product page with aluminum options and powdercoat finishes
- [Maglin Minis](https://www.maglin.com/collections/minis): Maglin Minis collection: children's furniture including 400 Series benches
- [Bancs sans dossier 400](https://www.maglin.com/fr/produit/bancs-sans-dossier-400): 400 Series backless bench product page (French)
- [Support à vélos 150](https://www.maglin.com/fr/produit/support-a-velos-150): 150 Series bike rack product page with LEED v4.1 specs (French)

## Featured Projects

- [The Battery Playscape](https://www.maglin.com/the-battery-playscape): Project: custom shade canopies and benches for Battery Playscape NYC
- [Introducing: ROMA Sun Shade](https://www.maglin.com/us/introducing-roma-sun-shade): Product launch article for ROMA Sun Shade by GIBILLERO Design
- [Enclave Heritage Courtyard at Otay Ranch](https://www.maglin.com/enclave-heritage-courtyard-at-otay-ranch): Case study: outdoor furniture for Otay Ranch apartment complex, Chula Vista
- [The Viridian Roof Deck Retreat](https://www.maglin.com/us/the-viridian-a-roof-deck-retreat): Case study: weather-resilient roof deck furniture near Fenway Park, Boston
- [Stonewall Station](https://www.maglin.com/us/stonewall-station): Project showcase: custom ipe benches at Novel Stonewall Station, Charlotte NC
- [Bernard Avenue Revitalization](https://www.maglin.com/bernard-avenue-revitalization): Project: custom curved benches for Bernard Avenue, Kelowna BC
